official_definition: Ultra Excite (Once per Turn: Same Name) At the end of the battle of your "Zero Contract" family Spirit, you can return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Ultra Excite] or [Ultra Excite: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Ultra Excite]", "give [Ultra Excite]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
